name: Luma
tagline: Luma Dream Machine is Luma AI's text-to-video and image-to-video model, producing smooth, photorealistic video clips with impressive lighting and motion quality. Unlike Luma's 3D capture products, Dream Machine is a pure video generation model accessible via a simple web interface. Creatives and agencies use it to produce high-quality video concepts and b-roll footage without a camera crew.
